lines.4: 「Thank you for waiting, everyone! It is time for the main event of the Sports and Martial Arts Festival: the Dragon Cup combat tournament to determine the strongest warrior!」
lines.5: 「The winner's army receives a whopping three hundred billion points! Forget the fine details and make it flashy!」
lines.6: 「Your announcer is yours truly, Ryuumeikan's mascot and Class 2-C's spiritual pillar, Kinu Kanisawa--」
lines.10: 「Our commentator is Otome Kurogane-senpai, an expert in martial arts!」
lines.12: 「And as our guest commentator, a word from Student Council President Erika Kiriya, who leads Ryuumeikan!」
lines.13: 「Men who fight are so wonderful. Do your best!」
lines.14: The Princess delivered some enthusiastic fan service.
lines.17: 「Our referee is the dragon born too late: Ryuumeikan Director Heizo Tachibana!」
lines.18: 「Long speeches here would be boorish! If you are men--」
lines.20: 「Oh! He has punched through steel dropped from a helicopter in a performance of supreme budgetary waste! Who will clean up the fragments?!」
lines.21: 「Yet behold the anachronistic spirit that lets him do this in modern Japan without hesitation! It shocks and inspires us! Every man longs to become a warrior like Heizo Tachibana!」
lines.23: 「Television cameras are rolling and magazine photographers are everywhere! Put on a good show and fame may make you popular! Burn hotter than the sun, warriors!」
lines.24: 「Now, let's begin with match one of the first round! A favorite appears immediately: Class 2-A's rational wolf, Yohei Murata!」
lines.25: 「I will win and prove that I am the strongest!」
lines.26: 「He has the proper look in his eyes. Splendid. That is how a warrior should be.」
lines.28: 「H-Hey, don't make such a fuss. It's embarrassing.」
lines.29: 「And his opponent is Class 2-C's secret weapon, Shinichi Samehyou!」
lines.30: 「Come on. Calling Fukahire a secret weapon is a painfully difficult joke. This isn't a comedy battle.」
lines.33: 「Oh, Samehyou has tremendous fighting spirit. He seems like a different person.」
lines.34: 「His DNA looks different! Something is obviously wrong here!」
lines.35: 「Heh heh... Shut up. We're supposed to speak with our fists here, aren't we?」
lines.37: 「The first match begins! Now is the hour for your soul to awaken!」
lines.42: 「Oh! A merciless beating! He won't stop! He cannot be stopped!」
lines.44: 「Technical knockout at thirty-two seconds of round one! Poor Murata is barely breathing!」
lines.46: 「Y-You people... used some suspicious... illegal technique... That's cheating...」
lines.47: 「Idiot. Only one fact matters: you lost. Keh-heh-heh-heh!」
lines.48: 「A win is a win. Ho ho ho ho!」
lines.50: 「Class 2-C's Shinichi Samehyou is the champion! The West Army gains three hundred billion points!」
lines.51: 「Yes! Now we're tied with the first-place East Army!」
lines.56: It is said that excessively powerful radio waves destroy the human body.
lines.59: When the evening star shines, one light ascends into the heavens... And that light is me...
